![Threat Monitor screensaver](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kuydigital/threat_monitor/main/docs/screens.png)

**Plain-English alerts.** Disaster and security headlines no longer show technical codes. "M7 … 10 thousand (in MMI>=VII)" now reads "magnitude 7 earthquake … 10 thousand people in at least very strong shaking", storm codes like "CHAMPI-26" become "tropical cyclone Champi" with how many people are in its strongest winds, and CVE numbers and short codes in brackets like "(XSS)" are left out. Created and maintained by Oliver Kuy.

Install the same way as before: on Windows, unzip and double-click **install.bat**; on a Mac, double-click **Threat Monitor.saver**. If you're updating on a Mac, log out and back in afterwards so macOS loads the new version.
